name: Cuban crocodile
desc: Endemic crocodile whose only wild population is in Zapata Swamp. Adults eat small mammals, fish and turtles.
about: The Cuban crocodile is a small-medium species of crocodile endemic to Cuba. Typical length is 2.1–2.3 m (6 ft 11 in – 7 ft 7 in) and typical weight 70–80 kg (150–180 lb).
